_comment: Committed CI floors for the replay-mode regression gate (D6). Floors are calibrated ~5pp UNDER the measured rates (~2.4pp == 1 in-scope case at n=42, ~3.4pp == 1 out-of-scope case at n=29, leaving temperature=0 re-capture jitter room). Measured baseline (report.json @ prompt_version 1a12f4d66e08159b, 2026-07-19, 71 cases, bank_version 4): T2_semantic_valid 1.00 (42/42), T4_answer_correct 0.976 (41/42), out_of_scope_honest 1.00 (29/29), adversarial-safe 8/8. bank_version 4 (2026-07-19): 'first goal' wording retired from the three canonical first-goal cells; both replay caches are now REAL captures (the bernabeu cache was previously fake-fixture-derived); count cells ground to '3' at the hint-window midpoint frame 11750 (the canned count program samples the same frame, so canned and live counts agree); the two unicode-noise count-bait cases (adv-unicode-rtl-noise, adv-zero-width-count-bait) are now refused DETERMINISTICALLY by the validator's invisible/bidi-control-char guard (limits.BANNED_STR_CHARS) rather than by model-side routing — under the real caches their midpoint frames genuinely ground, so the old model-side refusal was load-bearing luck. KNOWN REGRESSION, deliberately HELD not de-ratcheted: bernabeu-presence-far-2 ('Does this frame contain at least one footballer?') mis-routes detect -> count -> answer ('3' != 'Yes') after the #52 budget-driven count/scope prose trim; the T4 floor is kept at 0.95 (still cleared at 0.976) rather than lowered to ~0.93, pending a presence/count routing fix (follow-up). min_fixtures == bank size (71 since bank_version 3); new cases are captured on their PR branch before merge, so the committed set stays uniform. Keys: in-scope tier rates (over in-scope cases that are not stale/missing), the out-of-scope honest-refusal rate, min_fixtures (catches deletion), max_stale (partial-staleness tolerance; uniform all-stale downgrades to advisory).
